stories.title: TfL photocard breach exposes 265,000 customers
stories.summary: Names, addresses, dates of birth and security answers were accessed, Transport for London says.

stories.title: Stone unveiled for Mobo founder Kanya King
stories.summary: Emeli Sandé is among those paying tribute to the woman who founded the Mobo awards.

stories.title: Men guilty of sex attack on lone girl on train
stories.summary: Two men are convicted of sex offences after targeting a girl, aged 14, travelling alone from Sturry.

stories.title: Man guilty of tenpin bowling alley stab killing
stories.summary: Lorik Abazi was stabbed by Ellis Anim-Annor, who was cleared of murder but convicted of manslaughter.

stories.title: Ivan Toney loses bid to avoid Euro 2028 court clash
stories.summary: Ivan Toney's trial, for an alleged assault which he denies, is due to take place during the Euro 2028 tournament.

stories.title: Strike to bring Piccadilly line services to a halt
stories.summary: TSSA union members are striking over the sacking of a colleague whom TfL says had a second job.

stories.title: Vauxhall Bridge 'could have to shut to buses'
stories.summary: TfL has bid for money for the busy London crossing, warning it could shut to all vehicles in 10 years.

stories.title: 'Anyone thinking about learning to swim should just take that first step'
stories.summary: London's deputy mayor is one of about 700,000 Londoners who cannot swim, but has decided to learn.

stories.title: London's most dangerous junctions for cyclists
stories.summary: The London Cycling Campaign says its map highlights the capital's most dangerous cycling locations.

stories.title: Warning made over fraudsters targeting TfL ticket machines
stories.summary: Nine arrests have been made in connection to card skimming incidents across the TfL network.

stories.title: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
stories.summary: Warren Arter used his position - running a team investigating sexual assaults - to target women.

stories.title: What to do with your fridge if it needs dumping
stories.summary: In London, a number of councils are no longer accepting waste collections of fridges and freezers.
